datasets.help: The row with the column variable, the row variable and the optional value column, each column described individually under keys. Column and row variable are required for a grid. To clear, set one empty row ([{ x: null, g: null, v: null }]); [] is rejected.

x.label: X
x.title: Column variable (X — categorical)
x.help: The category column (slot x); its values become the columns of the grid. Required, empty until one is chosen.

g.label: G
g.title: Row variable (G — categorical)
g.help: The category column (slot g); its values become the rows of the grid. Required, empty until one is chosen.

v.label: V
v.title: Value column (numeric, optional — mean/sum per cell)
v.help: The value column (slot v), numeric and optional; without it each cell counts the rows of its combination. Empty until one is chosen.

aggregation.help: How the values of the value column are combined per cell: mean or sum. Takes effect only with a value column (slot v); without it each cell counts the rows of its combination.

stats.help: The heatmap grid, each figure described individually under keys; null while there is no grid (column or row variable empty, no valid pairs or a chosen column not readable).

activeParams.help: The fields that take effect in the current state: aggregation only with a value column set (slot v).

activeColumnSlots.help: The slot keys a row of the datasets carries: x, g, v.

grid.help: The levels of both axes and the value per cell from the chosen columns, as the chart draws them; an empty value cell is empty. Empty while there is no grid.

HeatmapStats.xCategories: The categories of the X column; they form the columns of the grid, the table shows them as column headers.
HeatmapStats.yCategories: The categories of the G column; they form the rows of the grid. The corner of the table shows “G column \ X column”: the name of the G column, then that of the X column; to its right the categories of the X column stand as column headers.
HeatmapStats.cells: The value per cell, ordered by row first, then by column, following the two category lists. Without a value column it is the number of rows with that combination, otherwise the mean or the sum of the value column. A combination without rows is empty; the table shows a dash there.
HeatmapStats.rowTotals: The total per row, in row order; empty cells do not count. The table shows it in the last column. For the mean there are no totals, then the field is empty.
HeatmapStats.colTotals: The total per column, in column order; empty cells do not count. The table shows it in the last row. For the mean there are no totals, then the field is empty.
HeatmapStats.total: The grand total of all cells; the table shows it at the bottom right under the “Total” header. For the mean there are no totals, then the field is empty.
